data.title: NHC Reports Second Quarter 2026 Earnings
data.description: National HealthCare Corporation, the oldest publicly traded senior health care firm in the US, revealed today that their net operating revenues for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, amounted to $408,025,000, marking an 8.8% rise from the $374,910,000 generated during the same period in 2025. This growth was mainly attributed to the recent acquisition of five skilled nursing facilities on June 1, 2026.

data.title: SoCalGas Board of Directors Approves Retirement of All Outstanding Shares of Preferred Stock
data.description: Today, in Los Angeles, Southern California Gas Company ("SoCalGas") disclosed that its board of directors has given the green light for the retirement of all existing shares of the company's 6% Preferred Stock, valued at $25 per share. This decision signifies a significant step for the company's financial operations.

data.title: PixVerse Kicks Off PixLight, a Global Competition for AI Filmmakers
data.description: Singapore-based company PixVerse has announced the launch of PixLight, an international competition aimed at filmmakers, screenwriters, and visual storytellers utilizing AI technology. The competition focuses on the quality of storytelling, emphasizing the development of compelling narratives with well-rounded characters and unique creative expression. Participants have the option to compete in two tracks: Pilot Track for creators prepared to submit a final film. The initiative encourages individuals to prioritize storytelling over showcasing AI capabilities.

data.title: Lomiko Metals Provides Update on Arrangement With Global Battery Materials, Loan Facility and Funding of the Yellow Fox Project
data.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia - Lomiko Metals Inc. has garnered increased shareholder backing for its recent deal with Global Battery Materials Corp. The agreement stipulates that Global Battery Materials Corp. will purchase all of Lomiko's common shares for C$0.13 per share. The transaction involves a court-approved process and is expected to include the acquisition of all outstanding common shares of Lomiko Metals Inc. This transaction is facilitated through the Toronto Stock Exchange Venture (LMR), OTC Markets Group (LMRMF), and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (DH8C).

data.title: Firy to Report 2026 Second Quarter Results on August 13, 2026 and Host a Conference Call and Webcast on August 14, 2026
data.description: In Las Vegas, Firy Inc. (NYSE: FIRY) disclosed plans to unveil its financial figures for the second quarter of 2026 after the market closes on August 13. The subsequent conference call and webcast are scheduled for August 14 at 9:00 a.m. ET, where FIRY's management will analyze the financial outcomes, offer a business overview, and engage in a Q&A session. data.title: Skull Ridge Gold Announces AGM Results and Strengthens Board with Appointments of Sean A. Kingsley and David Beek
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, on August 7, 2026, Skull Ridge Gold Corp. (CSE: SKUL) disclosed the outcomes of its Annual General Meeting on July 22, 2026. data.title: nCino Releases Mortgage MCP, Letting Lenders Connect AI Agents Directly to the nCino Mortgage Suite
data.description: A recent development has enabled an AI agent to operate within customers' environments without compromising nCino's compliance and permissioning framework. This new capability allows the AI agent to interact directly with customers, utilizing nCino's established regulatory protocols. This advancement is a significant step forward in providing personalized and efficient services to customers, with an emphasis on security and compliance. The integration of the AI agent into the customer environment opens up opportunities for enhanced communication and problem-solving, all while maintaining the integrity of nCino's regulatory framework.

data.title: Millrose Properties to Provide Capital Support for Dream Finders Homes' Announced Acquisition of Beazer Homes with Up to $1.25 Billion Commitment
data.description: In Miami, Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP, "Millrose"), a platform for residential homebuilders, revealed that its manager will offer acquisition financing of up to $1.25 billion to back Dream Finders Homes, Inc.’s ("Dream Finders") acquisition of Beazer Homes USA, Inc. This commitment marks the third time since Millrose's establishment that it has provided land banking capital to support such endeavors.

data.title: AD HOC GROUP REPRESENTING MAJORITY OF SHERRITT NOTEHOLDERS DISCLOSES RECAPITALISATION ALTERNATIVE AND CALLS ON BOARD TO ENGAGE
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Toronto, an informal group of investors owning the majority of Sherritt International Corporation's 9.25% 2031 Notes revealed details of a proposed recapitalization plan. This group, known as the Ad Hoc Group, shared important terms of the transaction aimed at restructuring Sherritt's debt obligations. The plan suggests significant changes to the company's financial structure and aims to address concerns related to the outstanding principal amount of the notes.

data.title: Starz Entertainment Corp. Reports Results for the Second Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
data.description: STARZ has revised its 2026 projections for Adjusted OIBDA and Unlevered Free Cash Flow, and has confirmed a year-end leverage target of 2.7x. The company has reported positive year-over-year growth in OTT revenue, prompting the increase in 2026 outlook targets for Adjusted OIBDA and Unlevered Free Cash Flow. Additionally, STARZ has reiterated its 2026 outlook targets.

data.title: MINISO Debuts First Kraków Pop-up Store, Bringing Its Immersive IP Experience to Another Polish City
data.description: MINISO, a popular retailer, launched its inaugural pop-up store at Galeria Krakowska in Kraków, Poland, on August 1, 2026. This move signifies MINISO's introduction to southern Poland and its growing presence in Europe. Galeria Krakowska, located in the center of Kraków, served as the ideal venue for the pop-up. This expansion highlights MINISO's strategic approach to capturing new markets and increasing its footprint globally.
